scripts.test: npm run build && node tooling/verify-deploy-target.mjs production && node --test tests/rendered-html.test.mjs tests/studio-runtime.test.mjs
scripts.deploy: npm run build && node tooling/verify-deploy-target.mjs production && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build:staging && node tooling/verify-deploy-target.mjs staging && wrangler d1 migrations apply STUDIO_DB --env staging --remote && wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.deploy:staging:dry-run: npm run build:staging && node tooling/verify-deploy-target.mjs staging && wrangler deploy --env staging --dry-run
scripts.migrate:staging:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply STUDIO_DB --env staging --local
